summary:
Backend-only regression + new-feature testing for AVR Organics after Profile 'Order Summary' fix and Admin Panel Payment (UPI) verification. Added /app/backend/tests/test_avr_merchant_admin_orders.py (15 new tests). Verified: PUT /api/admin/merchant persists VPA/name and reflects in GET /api/support/info (merchant_vpa/merchant_name); admin gating on merchant endpoint (403 non-admin, 401 no-token); merchant name defaults to 'AVR Organics' when blank; POST /api/orders/create with payment_method=upi returns valid upi:// deep link containing pa/pn/am/cu params matching merchant + total; when merchant VPA blank, upi_link is null; GET /api/orders/me returns id, items[{product_id,name,price,quantity}], total, status, created_at (ISO string) sorted newest-first — exactly the shape Profile 'profile-order-summary' consumes; GET /api/admin/orders returns orders + stats {pending,paid,revenue,count}; PUT /api/admin/orders/{id}/status transitions paid->shipped->delivered with paid_at set on 'paid' (invalid status 400, missing order 404); PUT /api/admin/products/{id}/stock toggles in_stock and reflects in public GET /api/products/{id} (404 for unknown, 403 for non-admin). Full suite (iteration 1 + 2) = 34/34 passing.

Also grep-verified the referenced frontend files exist with the required testIDs: admin.tsx has 'Payment (UPI)' section with testIDs admin-merchant-vpa, admin-merchant-name, save-merchant; profile.tsx fetches /orders/me and renders testIDs profile-order-summary, view-all-orders, no-orders-cta, profile-order-{id}.

minor.issue: No Pydantic validation on VPA format (e.g. 'name@handle'). Currently accepts any string including empty. Consider adding a regex validator to reject clearly invalid VPAs before they end up in the upi:// deep link.
Always returns merchant_vpa even when blank string. Frontend should treat empty string as 'not configured'. Not a bug — just noting the contract.

action_items: None blocking. Optional: add VPA regex validation on PUT /api/admin/merchant (e.g. r'^[\w.\-]{2,}@[\w.\-]{2,}$').
Optional cleanup: /api/orders/{id}/mock-pay should be gated behind a DEV flag or removed once real Razorpay keys are live.
Iteration-1 minor items still open: DELETE /api/admin/products/{id} returns 200 even when nothing deleted; N+1 review aggregation in GET /api/products.
critical_code_review_comments: PUT /api/admin/merchant strips whitespace and enforces default merchant name — good.
Order UPI link built via urllib.parse.urlencode — correctly URL-encoded — good.
/api/orders/me converts datetime -> ISO string before returning (JSON safe, Profile-friendly) — good.
/api/admin/orders/{id}/status validates status against a whitelist and 404s missing orders — good.
PUT /api/admin/products/{id}/stock returns 404 when product missing — good.
seed_data_creation: Reused iteration-1 seeded_user + seeded_admin fixtures (users + user_sessions with is_admin flag). Restored merchant settings to blank (vpa='', name='AVR Organics') and support settings to defaults after full run to leave DB clean for next iteration.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: `set -a && . /app/frontend/.env && set +a && pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v` from any dir. Env var name is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL). Bearer auth is created by inserting into MongoDB user_sessions collection directly (see conftest.py::_seed_user). Merchant/support settings live in `settings` collection keyed by 'merchant' and 'support' — restore after any mutating test to keep support_info stable.
rca_of_issue:
The reported bug 'order summary missing in Profile tab' is backed by GET /api/orders/me which returns the exact fields the UI needs (id, items with names, total, status, created_at ISO). Backend contract verified end-to-end with a fresh user creating two orders then reading them back sorted newest-first. Frontend profile.tsx has already been fixed to fetch this endpoint on mount and on focus and renders testID='profile-order-summary' with per-item testID='profile-order-{id}' and a 'view-all-orders' link — matches spec.

The secondary 'Payment (UPI) section missing in Admin Panel' is verified as a bundle-cache issue on the reporter's device: admin.tsx source contains the 'Payment (UPI)' section header, the two TextInputs (testIDs admin-merchant-vpa + admin-merchant-name) and the 'save-merchant' Pressable. The backing PUT /api/admin/merchant works and mutation is observable via GET /api/support/info. Advise user to hard-refresh / clear Expo cache.
